thread:
Lina Morales: Heads-up I opened a tiny docs PR to add a Go SDK example + a short migration checklist for teams moving from reserved pools to Dedicated. Also swapped a broken handbook anchor and tightened SLA wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4991 please skim the Go snippet and the SLA sentence.

Victor Chen: Nice. Few asks: 1) include a CLI example (redwoodctl) so platform teams can script migrations. 2) in SLA wording, avoid 'best-effort' — prefer 'not SLA-backed' for fallback tiers.

Ola Svensson: Go snippet looks good but can we show labels as map[string]string explicitly? Users miss tenant_label. Also add a short YAML snippet showing allocation.labels.

Priya Menon: On the migration checklist please add a step to "verify label propagation in the Console and metrics" after cutover. Many customers forget that.

Kenji Sato: Small nit on the SLA line: include a parenthetical note about maintenance windows causing preemption. e.g. "fallback tiers are not SLA-backed and may be preempted for maintenance or capacity constraints."

Lina Morales: Good calls. I'll add a redwoodctl CLI example and a YAML allocation snippet. I'll change SLA wording to Kenji's sentence and add the Console verification step.

Victor Chen: For the CLI example, suggest this pattern: `redwoodctl capacity create --name team-orion --region eu-west-1 --scale-policy throughput --min 2 --max 8 --cooldown 300 --label tenant=team-orion --label isolation=tenant` — shows flags and multiple labels.

Ola Svensson: Example YAML to include under migration:
```yaml
allocation:
  name: team-orion
  region: eu-west-1
  labels:
    tenant_label: "team-orion"
    isolation: "tenant"
  scale_policy:
    min_replicas: 2
    max_replicas: 8
    cooldown_seconds: 300
```

Lina Morales: Pasting the Go SDK snippet I'll add: 
```go
package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  redwood "github.com/redwood/inference-go"
)

func main() {
  client := redwood.NewDedicatedClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  cfg := redwood.CapacityConfig{
    Name: "team-orion-dedicated",
    Region: "eu-west-1",
    ScalePolicy: redwood.ScalePolicy{MinReplicas: 2, MaxReplicas: 8, CooldownSeconds: 300},
    Labels: map[string]string{"tenant_label": "team-orion", "isolation": "tenant"},
  }
  resp, err := client.CreateCapacity(cfg)
  if err != nil {
    fmt.Println("error:", err)
    return
  }
  fmt.Println(resp)
}
```

Priya Menon: Love it. Can you also add a short "smoke test" checklist entry in the PR: 1) migrate a dev tenant, 2) simulate 3x traffic spike, 3) observe scale-up within expected window, 4) confirm cooldown prevents rapid scale-down, 5) check Console labels & dashboards.

Lina Morales: Yep adding that. Also swapped the broken anchor to `#capacity-modes` per the handbook change. docs-bot: please re-run link-check when you get a sec.

docs-bot: Lint: docs/lint OK. Link-check: 1 outdated anchor replaced -> `#capacity-modes`.

Victor Chen: One last thought: add a short note in SLA/evictions section reminding customers that Dedicated SLOs apply to pinned model variants only; fallback/shared variants are not covered. Helps avoid confusion.

Lina Morales: Good call — will add that clarifying sentence and then merge after CI + Legal review of SLA phrasing. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Kenji Sato: lgtm

Ola Svensson: pushed a tiny tweak to the YAML example (indentation) as a follow-up commit.

Lina Morales: Merging after CI green and Legal thumbs.
